author: rorupuntou
content:
Following up on the recent merge of #3935, opened a companion PR extending boundary coverage for legacy transaction `v` values around the lower thresholds of EIP-155:
https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3955

Summary of additions in `test_chain_id.py`:
1. `test_legacy_chain_id_zero`: Tests `v` in `{35, 36}` (which mathematically encode `chain_id = 0`). Enforces strict rejection with `INVALID_CHAINID` across all active networks.
2. `test_legacy_v_sub_35`: Covers values outside pre-EIP-155 `{27, 28}` and below the base offset 35 (`v` in `{0, 1, 26, 29, 34}`). Accurately captures client divergence between explicit `v < 35` bounds checking (`INVALID_SIGNATURE_VRS`, e.g. Erigon, EELS, Nethermind) and uint64 arithmetic underflow deriving a mismatching chain ID (`INVALID_CHAINID`, e.g. Geth).

All 270 SpuriousDragon+ fixtures fill cleanly and `just static` passes.
